findings.title: Paperless container is running but failing its Docker healthcheck
findings.conclusion: Paperless (app-container-09db7bd0fc80b390) on docker01 is confirmed running but Docker-unhealthy. Root cause inside the container (hung process vs. blocked DB/Redis dependency) could not be confirmed because docker01's command agent is disconnected (command_agent_connected=false), which caused both the log read and the proposed restart action to fail ("action execution unavailable: Docker / Podman command agent is not connected"). Host-wide fault is ruled out since peer container nextcloud on the same host is healthy. An operator must restore docker01's Pulse command-agent connection, then inspect paperless logs and approve a restart if a stalled process is confirmed.
